author: fwyzard
body:
#### PR description:

Fix `L1TriggerJSONMonitoring` and `HLTriggerJSONMonitoring` for hostnames over 32 characters.
The call to `gethostname()` will fail with `ENAMETOOLONG` if the host name is longer than 32 characters.
Extend the buffer to `HOST_NAME_MAX + 1` characters to allow for all supported host names and a terminating NUL character, and throw on failure.

#### PR validation:

Tested on a host with a name longer than 32 characters.

#### Backport status

Backport of #52141 to 17.0.x.
title: [17.0] Fix HLT `JSONMonitoring` for hostnames over 32 characters
